19 const searchParams = req.nextUrl.searchParams;
20 const provider = searchParams.get('provider') || 'google';
21 const action = searchParams.get('action') || 'login';
22 const userId = searchParams.get('userId');
23
24 // If simulate query is passed, immediately create real session in database
25 if (searchParams.get('simulate') === 'true') {
26 const isGoogle = provider === 'google';
27
28 const testUser = {
29 name: isGoogle ? 'Demo Engineer (Google)' : 'personale88',
30 email: isGoogle ? 'developer@example.com' : 'personale88@users.noreply.github.com',
31 avatarUrl: isGoogle
32 ? 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?w=150&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80'
33 : 'https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/214250353?v=4',
34 };
35
36 if (action === 'connect' && userId) {
37 // Connect GitHub to existing user
38 linkOAuthAccount({
39 userId,
40 provider: 'github',
41 providerAccountId: '214250353',
42 accessToken: 'gho_dev_simulated_token_at_rest',
43 scope: 'read:user user:email repo',
44 });
45
46 saveConnectedGitHubAccount({
47 userId,
48 githubUsername: 'personale88',
49 githubId: '214250353',
50 avatarUrl: 'https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/214250353?v=4',
51 scope: 'read:user user:email repo',
52 });
53
54 return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/?github_connected=true', origin));
55 }
56
57 let user = testUser.email ? getUserByEmail(testUser.email) : null;
58 if (!user) {
59 user = createUser(testUser);
60 }
61
62 linkOAuthAccount({
63 userId: user.id,
64 provider: isGoogle ? 'google' : 'github',
65 providerAccountId: isGoogle ? 'google_sim_123' : '214250353',
66 accessToken: 'oauth_simulated_token_at_rest',
67 scope: isGoogle ? 'openid profile email' : 'read:user user:email repo',
68 });
69
70 if (!isGoogle) {
71 saveConnectedGitHubAccount({
72 userId: user.id,
73 githubUsername: 'personale88',
74 githubId: '214250353',
75 avatarUrl: testUser.avatarUrl,
76 scope: 'read:user user:email repo',
77 });
78 }
79
80 const session = createSession(user.id);
81 const response = NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/', origin));
82 setSessionCookie(response, session.id);
83 return response;
84 }
85
86 // Render clean informational page explaining setup
87 const providerName = provider === 'google' ? 'Google OAuth' : 'GitHub OAuth';
88 const callbackUrl = provider === 'google'
89 ? `${origin}/api/auth/callback/google`
90 : `${origin}/api/auth/callback/github`;
91
92 const html = `
93<!DOCTYPE html>
94<html lang="en">
95<head>
96 <meta charset="UTF-8">
97 <title>RepoPilot AI — OAuth Setup Guide</title>
98 <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
99 <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
100</head>
101<body class="bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen p-6 font-sans">
102 <div class="max-w-xl w-full bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-8 shadow-xl">
103 <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-6">
104 <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-lg">
105 RP
106 </div>
107 <div>
108 <h1 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900">${providerName} Setup Required</h1>
109 <p class="text-xs text-slate-500">Configure your OAuth app credentials in .env.local</p>
110 </div>
111 </div>
112
113 <div class="space-y-4 text-xs text-slate-600 leading-relaxed mb-6">
114 <div class="p-3.5 bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 rounded-xl text-indigo-900">
115 <p class="font-semibold mb-1">To connect real ${providerName}:</p>
116 <p>1. Register an OAuth application in your ${provider === 'google' ? 'Google Cloud Console' : 'GitHub Developer Settings'}.</p>
117 <p>2. Set the Authorization Callback URL to:</p>
118 <code class="block bg-white p-2 rounded mt-1.5 border border-indigo-200 font-mono text-slate-800 break-all select-all">${callbackUrl}</code>
119 <p class="mt-2">3. Add client credentials to your <code>.env.local</code> file:</p>
120 <pre class="bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 p-2.5 rounded mt-1 font-mono text-[11px] overflow-x-auto">${provider === 'google' ? 'GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=your-id\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your-secret' : 'GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=your-id\nGITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=your-secret'}</pre>
121 </div>
122
123 <div class="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl text-emerald-900 flex items-start gap-2">
124 <span class="font-bold text-emerald-600">✓</span>
125 <span>Local Development Mode: You can simulate a successful ${providerName} callback to verify the full dashboard and repository integration immediately.</span>
126 </div>
127 </div>
128
129 <div class="flex items-center gap-3 pt-2">
130 <a href="/api/auth/dev-mock?provider=${provider}&action=${action}&userId=${userId || ''}&simulate=true"
131 class="flex-1 py-2.5 px-4 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl text-center shadow-md transition-all">
132 Simulate ${providerName} Login (Local Dev)
133 </a>
134 <a href="/"
135 class="py-2.5 px-4 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 text-xs font-medium rounded-xl text-center transition-all">
136 Back to App
137 </a>
138 </div>
139 </div>
140</body>
141</html>
142 `;
143
144 return new NextResponse(html, {
145 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' },
146 });
147}
